embeds.title: 🔴 Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Vulnerability CVE-2026-20182 Exploited by UAT-8616
embeds.description:
**Actor:** UAT-8616
Cisco disclosed a max-severity authentication bypass zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-20182, CVSS 10.0) affecting Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager. Cisco reports that UAT-8616, a threat group previously linked to exploited vulnerabilities in Cisco firewalls and SD-WAN systems, has conducted a limited number of attacks exploiting this vulnerability. Rapid7 discovered and reported the vulnerability to Cisco on March 9, 2026, and Cisco became aware of limited exploitation earlier in May 2026. The vulnerability requires no credentials and affects all deployment types. CISA added the defect to its known exploited vulnerabilities catalog.

**CVEs:** CVE-2026-20182, CVE-2026-20127, CVE-2026-20122, CVE-2026-20128, CVE-2026-20133 • **Access:** Authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager
